headline: £200m carbon capture at Enfinium's Parc Adfer energy-from-waste plant recommended for approval
summary: A £200m carbon-capture extension to Enfinium's Parc Adfer energy-from-waste plant at Connah's Quay, Flintshire, is recommended for approval ahead of a 7 October Flintshire County Council committee vote; it would capture ~241,000 tonnes of CO2 a year (95% capture) from 232,000 t of residual waste and feed the HyNet pipeline for storage at Point of Ayr beneath the Irish Sea.
co2crc_note: Waste-to-energy capture tied into a shared T&S backbone (HyNet) is the hub-and-cluster model Australian clusters (e.g. CarbonNet) are pursuing; a useful planning/social-licence precedent.
extractor_note: amount is the stated project cost (capex), not a funding award. Committee decision scheduled 7 Oct 2026.

headline: Northern Lights signs Öresundskraft as its second Swedish customer
summary: The Northern Lights JV (Equinor, Shell, TotalEnergies) signed a transport-and-storage agreement for up to 200,000 tonnes of CO2 a year from Öresundskraft's Filbornaverket waste-to-energy CHP plant in Helsingborg; the CO2 will be trucked to Halmstad and shipped to Øygarden, Norway, for sub-seabed storage from Q4 2029, bringing Northern Lights to seven customers across four countries.
co2crc_note: Another cross-border (Sweden→Norway) ship-and-store contract validates the open-access T&S model Australia eyes for Bayu-Undan-style one-country-captures/another-stores chains.
extractor_note: Agreement value not disclosed; the ~SEK3bn Helsingborg investment (city-council approved May 2026) is the separate capture-plant capex, not this T&S deal — left null to avoid conflation.

headline: Cowboy Clean Fuels makes first durable carbon-removal sale in a Salesforce-backed round
summary: Wyoming's Cowboy Clean Fuels sold its first ~500 tonnes of durable carbon-removal credits through Milkywire's Salesforce-backed purchasing round (3,661 t across eight suppliers); its BiCRS+RNG process injects agricultural residues into unmineable coal seams where microbes convert the biomass to CO2 that binds to the coal (claimed >100-year permanence) while also producing renewable gas.
co2crc_note: Niche bio-CDR-plus-RNG route; mainly signals continued corporate demand for durable, geologically stored removals.
extractor_note: Deal volume 500 t (0.0005 Mtpa); Salesforce's US$100m durable-CDR-by-FY2031 figure is a corporate programme target, not this transaction — amount left null.

headline: Albertans say rights are 'being signed away' near the proposed Pathways CCS project
summary: Residents in Alberta communities near the Oil Sands Alliance's proposed Pathways CCS project say they have still not been consulted, two months before binding agreements are due — a social-licence flashpoint for one of the world's largest planned CCS schemes (the Pathways deal itself was in Friday's briefing).
co2crc_note: Community-consultation grievances on a flagship project are a live social-licence lesson for Australian CCS proponents.
extractor_note: Radar: dated 1 Oct, one day before the Mon window start (Fri 2 Oct); within 7 days.

headline: Absolute Climate opens consultation on an EAC methodology for gas power with carbon capture
summary: Absolute Climate released a draft Environmental Attribute Certificate (EAC) methodology for natural-gas power with CCS for a 45-day public consultation (open to 13 November 2026), aiming to let gas-CCS generators monetise unbundled low-carbon power attributes and close the sector's financing gap.
co2crc_note: New market mechanisms to bankroll gas-plus-CCS could broaden CCS revenue models relevant to Australian gas generation.
extractor_note: Radar: pub_date derived from the stated 45-day window ending 13 Nov 2026 (~30 Sep); exact date unconfirmed — WebFetch to the source domain was egress-blocked.
